=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3321-3329 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `git rev-list` failures are treated as the empty/no-ahead case because stderr is suppressed and the exit status is not handled, so the refresh guard can be bypassed or the function can fail unexpectedly.
  WHY: The command can hit real git errors (bad refs, permissions, shallow history, I/O), but the script does not distinguish them from a legitimate “no commits” result.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3317-3326 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The ahead-of-default check hard-codes `HEAD`, so it can miss legitimate ahead commits when the function runs with `HEAD` pointing somewhere other than the intended integration branch.
  WHY: In CI, detached-head, or post-merge contexts, comparing against the wrong tip can let the unwanted refresh/revert happen again.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3329-3333 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The `git rev-list` history gate can skip the refresh even when the file content would now make the refresh a no-op after a branch-only revert, leaving only a cosmetic skip.
  WHY: The gate keys off commit history rather than the current file state, so any integration-branch-only commit touching the file can suppress the refresh path.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3323-3336 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: `ahead_commit` is declared outside the loop but only used inside it, adding unnecessary scope and state.
  WHY: This does not break runtime behavior, but it makes the loop harder to read and maintain.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3323-3336 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: Running `git rev-list` once per file scales linearly with the `refresh_files` allowlist and adds avoidable process overhead.
  WHY: Each iteration spawns another git process, so larger allowlists will make the refresh slower.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:8029-8094 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The regression test inspects `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` as source text instead of exercising behavior, so formatting-only refactors can fail it.
  WHY: Exact function markers, brace style, loop structure, and literal strings are implementation details that can change without altering the safety property.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:8060-8061 | severity=low | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The `done_re` regex only matches a bare `done` line, so adding a trailing comment after `done` would make the test fail with a misleading loop-style error.
  WHY: The assertion is pinned to the current shell formatting instead of the semantic loop structure.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
